pages.text: Splits water with electricity. With a **Proton Exchange Membrane** in its slot it makes **hydrogen**: 1,000 mB from a bucket of water in ten seconds (the oxygen is let go). With the slot empty it concentrates **deuterium** instead: 1,000 mB from eight buckets. The membrane is never used up. Pipe water into its water tank (a [Water Pump](processing/water_pump) is easiest) and draw the gas off with a pipe or a gas canister. Draws 60 FE a tick.
